1. 修复 modern 模块可能无法保存设置的问题
2. 修正部分界面文案
3. 为彩色通知图标适配主题图标包
4. 修复占位符选项在 ColorOS 16+ 失效的问题
5. 其他功能优化，提升稳定性

# ColorOS Notification Icon Enhancer [![GitHub license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon?color=blue&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon/blob/master/LICENSE) [![GitHub CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon/commit_ci.yml?label=CI%20builds&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon/actions/workflows/commit_ci.yml) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon?display_name=release&logo=github&color=green&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon/releases) ![GitHub all releases](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon/total?label=downloads&style=flat-square) ![GitHub all releases](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.fankes.coloros.notify/total?label=LSPosed%20downloads&labelColor=F48FB1&style=flat-square) [![Telegram CI](https://img.shields.io/badge/CI%20builds-Telegram-blue.svg?logo=telegram&style=flat-square)](https://t.me/ColorOSNotifyIcon_CI) [![Telegram Channel](https://img.shields.io/badge/channel-Telegram-blue.svg?logo=telegram&style=flat-square)](https://t.me/XiaofangDaily) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/discussion-Telegram-blue.svg?logo=telegram&style=flat-square)](https://t.me/XiaofangInternet) [![QQ](https://img.shields.io/badge/discussion-QQ-blue.svg?logo=tencent-qq&logoColor=red&style=flat-square)](https://qm.qq.com/cgi-bin/qm/qr?k=dp2h5YhWiga9WWb_Oh7kSHmx01X8I8ii&jump_from=webapi&authKey=Za5CaFP0lk7+Zgsk2KpoBD7sSaYbeXbsDgFjiWelOeH4VSionpxFJ7V0qQBSqvFM) [![QQ Channel](https://img.shields.io/badge/discussion-QQ%20频道-blue.svg?logo=tencent-qq&logoColor=red&style=flat-square)](https://pd.qq.com/s/44gcy28h) English | [简体中文](README-zh-CN.md) Optimize notification icons for ColorOS and adapt to stock notification icon specifications. ## Project Migration Notice Maintaining two modules for both **HyperOS/MIUI** and **ColorOS** at the same time is very inconvenient, so I plan to gradually merge and decouple the two projects into a new one, with plans to support more systems and devices, such as AOSP and AOSP-like systems. The new project is [Sumi](https://github.com/fankes/Sumi), which is currently in development. After the new project publishes its official release, I will stop maintaining this project and recommend that everyone move to the new project. Features of this module that are unrelated to notification icons (for example, removing the developer options warning notification and the charging complete notification) will not be migrated to the new project. ## Compatibility Notes - **LSPosed** is recommended (scope: "System UI", if you want to adapt the Fluid Cloud notification icon function on ColorOS 16+, please add "System Messages") - It has only been tested on ColorOS 11, 12, 12.1, 13 and 17. If you have problems, please [submit an issue](https://github.com/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon/issues) - It is recommended to use ColorOS 11 or above ### Compatibility Changes Because ColorOS 15 changed the system notification icon behavior and forcibly replaces icons with the colored app icon during icon initialization, the "System Framework" scope has been added. If this scope is not checked automatically after the module is installed, please check it manually and restart the system to fix this breakage. Systems older than ColorOS 15 do not need to check it. Thanks to [Nep-Timeline](https://github.com/Nep-Timeline) for providing the solution. ## Background ColorOS, the second-largest system after MIUI, supports stock notification icons, but it has not been adapted for the colorful icons pushed by third parties, and even the system's own icons are colored, which is extremely unfriendly. Moreover, starting from ColorOS 12 the stock icons lost their tint attribute, which is also a kind of damage to the stock Android ecosystem. In ColorOS 15 and later, the system even forcibly replaces icons with the colored app icon during icon initialization. ## Contribute to the ANIP The notification icons of this project come from the ANIP project. [Click here](https://github.com/BetterAndroid/android-notification-icon-project) for details. ## Release Channels | | [GitHub CI](https://github.com/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon/actions/workflows/commit_ci.yml) | CI automatic builds (beta) | |------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------| | | [Telegram CI Channel](https://t.me/ColorOSNotifyIcon_CI) | CI automatic builds (beta) | |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------| | | [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/fankes/ColorOSNotifyIcon/releases) | Official releases (stable) | |------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------| | | [Xposed-Modules-Repo](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.fankes.coloros.notify/releases) | Official releases (stable) | |------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------| The release addresses of this module are limited to those listed above. We are not responsible for any impact caused by versions downloaded from other unofficial channels. ### Choose a Module Version by Scenario The installation packages of this project come in two tracks: **modern** and **legacy**. - Versions marked **modern** are for Xposed frameworks that support the libxposed API, such as LSPosed - Versions marked **legacy** are for Xposed frameworks that support the Xposed Framework API, such as old LSPosed (≤ 1.9.0), EdXposed, etc. The **modern** version supports automatic hot reload on LSPosed 2.1.0+. After the first installation, later module updates take effect without restarting System UI. ## Notes 1. This software is free and developed out of interest, for learning and communication only.
